notes: Detected foci are compact, discrete bodies occupying a small fraction of the nucleoplasm, consistent with pericentromeric heterochromatin/chromocenters. Median of 15.5 per nucleus (IQR 12.5–18.5) aligns well with the expected 'few tens' target; the visible per-slice counts in the montage (a handful of colored objects per nucleus) are consistent with that 3D total. No obvious over-splitting of large chromocenters or spurious noise picks are apparent, though the high-count outlier cells (183, 202) warrant a spot-check to rule out noise detection in those nuclei.
